--- revoke_queue_multiple.sql
REVOKE SELECT, INSERT, DELETE ON QUEUE Q, `queue` FROM ROLE producer, consumer

--- AST
&ast.Revoke{
  Privilege: &ast.PrivilegeOnQueue{
    Privileges: []ast.TablePrivilege{
      &ast.SelectPrivilege{
        Select: 7,
        Rparen: -1,
      },
      &ast.InsertPrivilege{
        Insert: 15,
        Rparen: -1,
      },
      &ast.DeletePrivilege{
        Delete: 23,
      },
    },
    Names: []*ast.Path{
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 39,
            NameEnd: 40,
            Name:    "Q",
          },
        },
      },
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 42,
            NameEnd: 49,
            Name:    "queue",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 60,
      NameEnd: 68,
      Name:    "producer",
    },
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 70,
      NameEnd: 78,
      Name:    "consumer",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
REVOKE SELECT, INSERT, DELETE ON QUEUE Q, queue FROM ROLE producer, consumer
